mechanism: Propranolol (CYP2D6 inhibitor) increases atomoxetine plasma concentrations; additive effects on heart rate and blood pressure; atomoxetine has sympathomimetic properties that may partially counteract beta-blockade.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and atomoxetine efficacy/tolerability; consider dose adjustment of atomoxetine or alternative ADHD medication; ensure cardiac function is stable.
